_note: Hand-authored ideal extraction for bracketed-sender-address.eml. Reproduces a real live bug: a bare '<no-reply@...>' From: header with no display name - the model sometimes copies that whole bracketed token verbatim into sender.name/sender.email instead of the bare address. guardBracketedSenderFields strips it, so sender.name should end up empty here, not the literal string.
